phase_name: Rewrite the EXCEPTIONS block with measured floors

objectives.description: Replace the stale, inert single EXCEPTIONS entry with three accurate per-agent entries
objectives.note: Replaced the single stale entry (general-implementation-agent, cap 8,048, naming patterns/checkpoint-execution.md which is no longer referenced) with three entries keyed on the Phase 7 measured totals: general-implementation-agent (measured 16,688, cap 17,188), neovim-implementation-agent (measured 15,336, cap 15,836), nix-implementation-agent (measured 14,104, cap 14,604). Each cap = measured total + 500-token deliberate headroom, documented inline. Justification text names the full entry-by-entry composition from Phase 7's --verbose listing, grouped as the shared 9,248-token core bundle plus each agent's specific unconditional domain content.

objectives.description: Generalize the hardcoded summary narration block into a loop over EXCEPTIONS
objectives.note: Added EXCEPTIONS_APPLIED_TOTALS associative array, populated in the Agent Budget Check loop only when an agent's exception actually fires this run. The summary block now loops over that array's keys, reading cap/justification live from EXCEPTIONS, so the narration and the array can never drift apart again -- this is the direct fix for the exact defect this file's own history demonstrated (the old block printed general-implementation-agent's stale composition as literal text regardless of EXCEPTIONS contents).

objectives.description: Add a maintenance note about recomputation
objectives.note: Added a comment block above the EXCEPTIONS declaration stating: caps are computed from file sizes measured at authoring time; recompute via --verbose whenever a named file's content size changes; the structural cause is core-doc size (the 9,248-token shared bundle), not hook authorship; and an explicit warning against letting a cap go stale and inert the way the prior single entry did.

objectives.description: Confirm no task-number references appear in the added text
objectives.note: bash .claude/scripts/check-task-references.sh: PASS, 0 unexempted occurrences across all 4 scanned trees including agent-system/extensions.

objectives.description: Verify: bash -n, no stale literals, full validator run
objectives.note: bash -n passes. Confirmed no 'echo' statement contains the stale literals (checkpoint-execution, 8,048/8048, 4,016) -- only explanatory comments describing the historical defect for future maintainers reference them, never printed output. After deploy-headless.sh: validate-context-budgets.sh reports Violations: 0, exit 0, exactly 3 OK* rows with narration exactly matching EXCEPTIONS array contents. No CAPS value changed (meta-builder-agent/planner-agent still 15000, all others still 8000).
